name: AI research practice
compute: Free Colab/Kaggle only; GPU type, quota and availability must be recorded, never assumed.
primary_question: How do we make language-model systems reliable and resource-aware when their tools, memory and evaluators are imperfect?

flagships.name: Failure-aware agents and trustworthy evaluation
flagships.mechanism: Typed state transitions, observable recovery, matched call budgets and independently checked failure attribution.
flagships.nearest_work: AgentRx, tau2-Bench, AgentDojo and reliability/evaluation studies.
flagships.hypothesis: A measured fault-aware policy may improve success at fixed cost on some unseen fault conditions.
flagships.kill: No advantage over conventional step retry; unsafe actions increase; or evaluator/oracle leakage explains the effect.
flagships.status: Baseline harness started; checkpoint-only advantage already null under a stronger synthetic baseline.

flagships.name: Temporal memory and efficient inference
flagships.mechanism: Version/expiry-aware evidence plus an explicitly budgeted retrieval and inference controller.
flagships.nearest_work: LongMemEval, HippoRAG2, adaptive speculation and KV-cache research.
flagships.hypothesis: Validity-aware memory may reduce stale answers without collapsing useful-answer coverage at equal resource budgets.
flagships.kill: Matched retrieval baselines erase benefit; extra calls explain it; or abstaining on everything wins the metric.
flagships.status: Candidate; nearest-method full reads and pilot required.

flagships.name: Grounded observation under stale visual evidence
flagships.mechanism: A small frozen VLM with timestamps and a budgeted request for fresh observations on controlled video scenes.
flagships.nearest_work: V-JEPA2, SmolVLM/SmolVLA, recent video and embodied evaluation.
flagships.hypothesis: A calibrated refresh rule may improve temporal state answers at matched frame/token budgets.
flagships.kill: Simple recency or uniform sampling matches the rule; scene-generator leakage explains success; or GPU allocation cannot support the pilot.
flagships.status: Candidate; not a new world-model training project or hardware robotics claim.

projects.title: Agent failure replay bench
projects.question: What fails, and does the evaluator expose it?
projects.baseline: No retry, restart retry, conventional step retry
projects.deliverable: Versioned synthetic tasks, failure taxonomy, JSONL traces and tested evaluator
projects.gate: Oracle hidden from policies; failed calls charged; strong baseline included

projects.title: Real small-model tool policy
projects.question: Can a free-GPU open model obey the same action contract?
projects.baseline: Deterministic policy and raw model output
projects.deliverable: Colab/Kaggle notebook, frozen checkpoint/prompt, schema failures and run receipts
projects.gate: One actual held-out model run; malformed proposals retained; no replay-as-LLM claim

projects.title: Fault and checkpoint ablations
projects.question: Does any gain survive ordinary retry and matched budgets?
projects.baseline: State-retaining step retry
projects.deliverable: Paired fault matrix and ablation report
projects.gate: Null results retained and all compared policies share total budgets

projects.title: Judge order and verbosity audit
projects.question: How often does the judge change its answer when presentation changes?
projects.baseline: Original/swapped order, length-controlled pairs
projects.deliverable: Judge perturbation harness and agreement/calibration plots
projects.gate: No answer labels derived from the tested judge; held-out annotated cases

projects.title: Selective prediction and abstention
projects.question: Can uncertainty reduce wrong actions without refusing everything?
projects.baseline: Always act, fixed abstention threshold
projects.deliverable: Risk-coverage and cost-success curves
projects.gate: Thresholds tuned only on development cases; task-cluster intervals

projects.title: Benchmark leakage and reward audit
projects.question: Can a policy score without doing the intended task?
projects.baseline: Simple exploit probes versus task-state oracle
projects.deliverable: Evaluator adversarial tests and dataset card
projects.gate: Synthetic/owned targets only; no benchmark exploit deployed externally

projects.title: Retrieval baseline workbench
projects.question: Where do lexical and dense retrieval differ?
projects.baseline: BM25/TF-IDF, frozen dense embeddings, matched top-k
projects.deliverable: Licensed corpus/split manifest and retrieval metrics
projects.gate: Retrieval relevance is distinct from answer entailment; no test tuning

projects.title: Context position stress test
projects.question: Does evidence position change answers at fixed context length?
projects.baseline: Short oracle passage, uniform placement, retrieval
projects.deliverable: Position/length sweeps with identical questions
projects.gate: Actual context supported by checkpoint; no million-token claim from marketing

projects.title: Versioned memory under updates
projects.question: Will the system distinguish current evidence from superseded facts?
projects.baseline: Recent-k, dense retrieval, explicit timestamp filter
projects.deliverable: Update/delete/contradiction task generator and memory traces
projects.gate: No oracle fields exposed; deletion claims limited to tested storage layers

projects.title: Compute-aware routing
projects.question: When should the system retrieve, call a larger model, or abstain?
projects.baseline: Always-small, always-large where feasible, simple threshold
projects.deliverable: Budget sweep and router ablations
projects.gate: Charge every branch/call, match tuning budget, report coverage

projects.title: Speculative decoding correctness
projects.question: Which draft lengths help after draft overhead is included?
projects.baseline: Same target autoregressive decoding
projects.deliverable: Tiny numerical reference then compatible small-model pilot
projects.gate: Greedy equality versus stochastic distribution claims separated

projects.title: KV-cache allocation and memory map
projects.question: Where does fragmentation or eviction dominate?
projects.baseline: Contiguous and blocked allocation
projects.deliverable: Allocator tests, synthetic workload and conditional GPU receipt
projects.gate: Simulated byte accounting not called measured latency or VRAM

projects.title: Attention kernel measurement
projects.question: Is the path compute-bound or memory-bound on the allocated GPU?
projects.baseline: Reference attention and supported PyTorch SDPA backend
projects.deliverable: Numerical tests and synchronized benchmark traces
projects.gate: Record backend/GPU; Blackwell-only methods remain reading-only on T4/P100

projects.title: Quantization quality-resource frontier
projects.question: What is lost when a checkpoint uses less memory?
projects.baseline: Same model unquantized where it fits
projects.deliverable: Quality, peak-memory and latency comparison
projects.gate: Same tokenizer/tasks; unavailable baseline is explicit, not fabricated

projects.title: Small-model adaptation
projects.question: Does a small LoRA adapter beat a good prompt or retrieval baseline?
projects.baseline: Prompt-only, retrieval, small SFT
projects.deliverable: Short resumable training run and adapter card
projects.gate: Dataset/model licenses recorded; no full model pretraining claim

projects.title: Verifiable RL learning dynamics
projects.question: What changes under reward optimization on a narrow verifiable task?
projects.baseline: SFT and simple REINFORCE on a tiny task
projects.deliverable: Reward/accuracy/length curves and exact verifier tests
projects.gate: No claim of reproducing full DeepSeek-R1; no judge-based reward leakage

projects.title: Preference learning stress test
projects.question: Does preference optimization improve anything beyond length/style?
projects.baseline: SFT, length-controlled evaluation, tiny DPO
projects.deliverable: Preference data audit and held-out comparison
projects.gate: Independent evaluation and reference-policy costs included

projects.title: Representation and causal probe
projects.question: Is the observed feature causal or just correlated with behavior?
projects.baseline: Random/control probes and intervention-free prediction
projects.deliverable: Small-model activation/probe experiment
projects.gate: Probe accuracy alone is not a causal explanation or faithful reasoning

projects.title: Small VLM grounding
projects.question: Does the model use the image rather than language priors?
projects.baseline: Text-only, image-shuffled, frozen small VLM
projects.deliverable: Grounded scene tests and visual perturbation report
projects.gate: Controlled rendering, unseen scene seeds, same text/frame budget

projects.title: Stale video observation benchmark
projects.question: When does an old observation become unsafe to use?
projects.baseline: Last-frame, uniform frames, fixed recency refresh
projects.deliverable: Temporal scene generator and timestamp-aware evaluation
projects.gate: Simulator state is evaluator-only; no world-model training claim

projects.title: Offline embodied decision analysis
projects.question: Which failures follow from stale observations versus action policy?
projects.baseline: Frozen trajectories and simple state estimator
projects.deliverable: Licensed offline trajectory subset or owned simulator study
projects.gate: No live robot, simulator execution, or real-world safety claim unless actually run

projects.title: Hugging Face research artifact
projects.question: Can another person reproduce and inspect the work?
projects.baseline: Clean environment replay
projects.deliverable: Space source, dataset/adapter cards where justified, bounded demo
projects.gate: User-owned account/auth required to upload; no secrets or fabricated model release

projects.title: Frozen flagship replication
projects.question: Does the chosen result survive held-out tasks and another seed/session?
projects.baseline: Strongest matched conventional method
projects.deliverable: Preregistered final matrix, raw runs, paired intervals and negative results
projects.gate: Choose one primary contribution; no post-hoc hypothesis switch

projects.title: Paper and research talk
projects.question: Can the claim be stated, defended and rerun?
projects.baseline: Reviewer-style claim/evidence audit
projects.deliverable: Paper draft, artifact release, five-minute talk and research statement
projects.gate: Venue-specific checklist and mentor review before any submission

publication_boundary: Submission readiness is a goal; novelty, acceptance, stars, recruitment and admission are not guaranteed. No paper/application submission is authorized by creating this plan.
